# codex

```go
import "github.com/rou-cru/takt-ai/takt/agents/codex"
```

Package codex renders OpenAI Codex agent files: custom\-agent TOML, global prompt Markdown, and config.toml.

## Constants

<a name="Context7RemoteURL"></a>Context7RemoteURL is the canonical context7 remote MCP endpoint deployed into Codex config.toml by the context7 component.

```go
const Context7RemoteURL = shared.Context7RemoteURL
```

<a name="NewManagedPaths"></a>
## func NewManagedPaths

```go
func NewManagedPaths(generated []string) ([]string, error)
```

NewManagedPaths returns Takt\-owned Codex paths relative to the user's home directory: the native paths plus the renderer\-generated ones, normalized and sorted. Every path not listed is outside this ownership contract and is preserved by future lifecycle consumers.

ValidSandboxMode reports whether mode is a supported native Codex sandbox mode.

<a name="Artifact"></a>
## type Artifact

Artifact is a filesystem\-free Codex projection. Path is relative to the user's home directory and Content is ready for a later deployer to write.

```go
type Artifact = shared.Artifact
```

<a name="ConfigRequest"></a>
## type ConfigRequest

ConfigRequest contains the native Codex global configuration projection.

```go
type ConfigRequest struct {
    Assignment  model.ModelAssignment
    SandboxMode SandboxMode
    WebSearch   WebSearch
    MultiAgent  bool
    MaxThreads  int
    MaxDepth    int
    // Context7 adds the canonical context7 remote MCP server block.
    Context7 bool
    // Permissions adds the canonical takt-dev permission profile.
    Permissions bool
}
```

<a name="SubAgentRequest"></a>
## type SubAgentRequest

SubAgentRequest contains the native data needed for one Codex agent file.

```go
type SubAgentRequest struct {
    ID           string
    Description  string
    Instructions string
    Assignment   model.ModelAssignment
    SandboxMode  SandboxMode
    WebSearch    WebSearch
}
```
